ento-.definition: A combining form signifying within; as, entoblast.

entoblast.translation:
n. 内胚层

entogastric.translation:
a. 胃内的
[医] 胃内的

entoglossal.definition: a. Within the tongue; -- applied to the glossohyal bone.

entolomataceae.translation: [网络] 粉褶菌科；粉褶伞科；红褶菇科

entomb.definition: v place in a grave or tomb

n. 昆虫学

n. pl. One of a group of hymenopterous insects whose
   larvae feed parasitically upon living insects. See Ichneumon, 2.
n. pl. A group of marsupials which are partly
   insectivorous, as the opossum.
n. pl. A group of edentates, including the ant-eaters.

entomophagous.translation: a. 食虫的,以昆虫为食的

entomophilous.translation:

entomostraca.definition:
n. pl. One of the subclasses of Crustacea, including a
   large number of species, many of them minute. The group embraces
   several orders; as the Phyllopoda, Ostracoda, Copepoda, and
   Pectostraca. See Copepoda, Phyllopoda, and Cladocera.

entomostracan.definition:
a. Relating to the Entomostraca.
n. One of the Entomostraca.
entomostracan.translation: a. 切甲类的,昆甲类的

entoparasite.translation: n. 内部寄生物, 体内寄生虫

entophyte.definition:
n. A vegetable parasite subsisting in the interior of the
   body.

entophytic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to entophytes; as, an entophytic
   disease.

entoplasm.definition:
n. The inner granular layer of protoplasm in a developing
   ovum.
n. Endosarc.

entoplastic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or composed of, entoplasm; as, the
   entoplastic products of some Protozoa, or the entoplastic modification
   of the cell protoplasm, by which a nucleus is produced.

entoplastron.definition:
n. The median plate of the plastron of turtles; --
   called also entosternum.

entoproct.definition: n any of various moss-like aquatic animals usually forming branching colonies; each polyp having a both mouth and anus within a closed ring of tentacles

entoprocta.definition:
n. pl. A group of Bryozoa in which the anus is within the
   circle of tentacles. See Pedicellina.

entoptic.definition:
a. Relating to objects situated within the eye; esp.,
   relating to the perception of objects in one's own eye.

entoptoscopy.translation: [医] 眼内媒质镜检查, 眼内填质镜检查

entosthoblast.definition:

   nucleated cell.

entotic.definition: a. Pertaining to the interior of the ear.
